The most popular outfit - which is also my favorite - was inspired by Goldfrapp. Even though my ankle was aching at the end, I felt so happy!
output.sadness: I had downed 3 coffees, but the stress was overwhelming. My booth was simple and hastily assembled. Even though I sold out in 20 minutes and met some lovely people, I still felt a heaviness inside. The outfit that everyone loved, my absolute favorite inspired by Goldfrapp, didn’t bring me the joy I hoped for. By the end of the show, my ankle was throbbing in pain.
output.fear: I had had 3 coffees and was stressed to an extreme level. My booth was hastily thrown together, which made me anxious. I was relieved to sell out in just 20 minutes and meet friendly faces, but I couldn't shake the fear of failure. The outfit that became so popular, my favorite, was inspired by Goldfrapp. However, as the show ended, I feared I'd really hurt my ankle.
output.anger: After 3 coffees, I was stressed to the MAXIMUM, and it was infuriating! My booth, though simple, was thrown together in a rush. Selling out in just 20 minutes and meeting such lovely people barely made up for it. The most popular outfit — my personal favorite, inspired by Goldfrapp — should've been the highlight, but instead, I was left in pain with a throbbing ankle at the end.
output.surprise: I had consumed 3 coffees and was stressed to the MAXIMUM! To my astonishment, my booth was incredibly simple and thrown together quickly. I was surprised to sell out in just 20 minutes and meet the most wonderful people. The outfit that stole the show, and is also my favorite, was brilliantly inspired by Goldfrapp. But, surprisingly, my ankle was killing me by the end!
output.disgust: After downing 3 coffees, I was stressed to an extreme level—it felt unbearable! My booth was just a simple mess thrown together quickly. The outfit that everyone liked, which I reluctantly admit was inspired by Goldfrapp, wasn't enough to overshadow the pain in my ankle at the end.
